title: 3.13 Unit 3 Review
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Review Unit 3 through fresh scenes: greetings and names, speaker perspective and current action, yes/no questions, ages, countries and nationalities, jobs, and possession with my/your/his/her, our/their, 's and yours. No new language.
grammar_function: Hello/Good morning/Goodbye; What is your name? My name is...; I am/you are/we are; What are you doing? I am + -ing; How old are you? I am ... years old; Where are you from? I am from... / I am + nationality; What is your job? I am a...; he/she is; my/your/his/her; have/has. Is she cooking? Yes, she is.; our/their; name + 's; It is yours.
speaking_outcome: Say six Unit 3 lines aloud across greeting, identity, age, current action, job and possession.
